paragraphs.text: Swimming in rivers and lakes has become popular again. Clubs report that most new members are over forty, and many say they started during the winter, when the water is coldest.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Doctors advise caution. Cold water can cause the body to gasp, which is dangerous far from the bank, and swimmers are told to enter slowly and never to swim alone. There is no national record of accidents.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: Most people who join swimming clubs are young.
Swimmers are advised to go into the water slowly.
The number of accidents has fallen in recent years.
Cold water can make a swimmer gasp.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
